description:
Content package that installs the aem-loki-integrator.core bundle under
        /apps/aem-loki-integrator-packages/application/install. The 2.x forwarder
        uses only the OSGi Log Reader Service and java.net.http, so no fragment
        or Logback appender is embedded. No default OSGi configuration is
        shipped; the forwarder stays dormant until a configuration for
        com.adobexp.aem.loki.LogbackLokiBootstrap is deployed by the consuming
        project (see ../example-osgi-config).
